summary: Cosine::built_distance divided by any nonzero norm product and left the cosine unclamped, allowing floating-point rounding to produce distances outside [0, 1]. The fix requires the divisor to exceed f32::EPSILON and clamps the cosine to [-1, 1] before computing (1 - cos) / 2. The verbatim reversal is uniquely identified, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision. The fix adds no tests; tests::reader::search_in_db_with_a_single_vector uses values yielding zero distance under both implementations, and the existing cosine writer tests do not assert the affected numerical behavior. Leave this candidate blocked for lack of a detecting test; no upstream builds or tests were run.
